visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with dark hair and sunglasses stands at a dock, wearing a long grey button-down dress and holding a white shopping bag. Next to her is a bright green suitcase. Looming behind her is the massive white hull of the 'SEVEN SEAS' cruise ship under a bright blue, cloudless sky. (2) Inside an outdoor dining area on the ship, the woman sits at a table draped in white. She is enjoying a breakfast spread featuring a bowl of mixed fruit, a croissant, coffee, and sliced meats. The background reveals a wide, calm sea and a steep coastal mountain. (3) The camera shifts to various panoramic shots of the Amalfi Coast. Blue waters are dotted with white yachts and ferries. Colorful houses are clustered on the cliffs under a hazy sun. (4) The woman explores a town square wearing a blue off-shoulder top and white shorts. She walks past an ornate cathedral with a grand staircase where many tourists are seated. (5) Close-up shots of food appear, specifically a large yellow lemon filled with creamy gelato being scooped with a spoon, and a plate of linguine topped with fresh black mussels and parsley. (6) The final scenes show a sprawling beach packed with multicolored umbrellas and sunbathers, followed by the woman posing on a black metal railing with the town and mountains behind her.
